description: A race contest's live race: every racing entry run live over the ranking phase's window as the recorder takes the bars, provisional and deciding nothing; the result is the official replay of the recorded window. status: none (no race), scheduled (before window.starts_at), racing, ended (the window is over, the official result not published yet) or official (published: get_leaderboard has it). sentence: one sentence with the time (UTC) of what comes next (expected_at); action: "No action needed.". window (starts_at, ends_at, bars) and interval; rules: requires_dev_profit (only a final entry whose latest dev grade netted above 0 USDC after every fee races and is graded on the final: the dev gate), max_racers, lag_note_bars. symbols (each one's price_scale: a close c is c / 10^price_scale USDC) and tape: each bar's closes by seq; head: the latest bar's seq. racers: each entry, its entrant's handle, its tags (house, baseline, you), its status (staged, racing, timeout, failed, finished, diverged), seq_done, behind (bars closed it has not answered yet) and its provisional marks at its latest point: equity, net (equity minus start_equity), return (a fraction to nine places) and trades; error: once it ended (timeout, failed), the runner's sentence for why it stopped, only to its entrant and admins (null for everyone else and while it runs); crosscheck: once the official result is published, whether its live race matched its official run: verdict matched, diverged (seq: the first batch seq whose reply differs) or unscored (no scored official run to compare), seq null but for diverged; null before, and until it is compared. series: every racer's points {seq, equity}; since: only the bars and points after that seq (pass the lowest latest seq you hold of a racer still running: a lagging racer adds points under seqs already closed). frame: the race as the live board reads it, ranked by equity, an exact tie to the earlier receipt; its footnote "Provisional live marks; the result is the official replay of the recorded window". Money is integers of unit (USDC quote units). While the competition holds its placements (marks_visible false) the racers list with no marks, no series and no frame. House and internal entries are left out here. `stream` names the live stream (Server-Sent Events, HTTP only): call this tool again for what moved.

since.description: Only the bars and points after this seq (-1: from the first batch); default every one

slug.description: The competition slug, e.g. chess-engine-01 (list_competitions lists them)

name: get_race
title: Get a race contest's live race
